- **Sizes:** 24px, 36px, 48px, 64px, 74px
- **Line height:** 1.083 to 1.333 (52px at 48, 72px at 64, 84px at 74, 44px at 36, 32px at 24)

- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 10px, 11px, 12px, 14px
- **Line height:** 1.45 at 11px, 1.57 at 14px, 2.0 at 12px, 2.4 at 10px
- **Letter spacing:** +0.33px at 11px, -0.12px at 12px, -0.1px at 10px, normal at 14px

| body-sm | Inter | 400 | 14px | 1.57 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Inter | 400 | 16px | 1.625 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| subheading | Aeonik Pro | 500 | 24px | 1.333 | -0.24px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Aeonik Pro | 400 | 36px | 1.222 | -0.36px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Aeonik Pro | 500 | 48px | 1.083 | -0.72px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | Aeonik Pro | 500 | 64px | 1.125 | -0.96px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Aeonik Pro | 500 | 74px | 1.135 | -1.11px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline in Aeonik Pro weight 500 with -1.5% tracking (-1.11px at 74px, -0.72px at 48px) — weight 500 gives authority on the gradient without the heaviness of 700.
- Open each section with a Geist Mono 11px weight 500 uppercase eyebrow at 0.33px tracking inside a 999px pill — the mono label is the page's most frequent style and its developer signature.
- Descend from Onyx Night #05061b to Paper Canvas #ffffff exactly once per page — the single sunrise is the narrative, and repeating it flattens it.
- Reserve Signal Blue #0036ff for the primary pill, active toggles and the support launcher — one action color keeps the click path unambiguous.
- Separate surfaces by tone, using Mist Panel #0000000a under #ffffff tiles with `--shadow-sm` — tonal stacking replaces bordered boxes.
- Nest radii concentrically: a 24px panel, then a 20px tile, then 14px windows, then 10px images — the corners read as one machined object.
- Keep body copy at Inter 14px weight 400 with 22px leading in #656565 — explanation should stay quieter than the 48px headings above it.

### Don't

- Don't set Aeonik headlines at weight 700 — the 500 cut against -1.5% tracking is the signature, and bold turns the composed sunrise into a generic launch page.
- Don't keep the whole page dark — the thesis is a descent from night to white paper, and the conventional dev-tool all-dark scheme deletes the arrival at #ffffff.
- Don't use 8px rounded rectangles for buttons — every clickable shape is a 999px capsule, and a square corner reads as a foreign component.
- Don't add a 1px #00000014 border around Feature Panel Cards — the 4% #0000000a tint already separates them, and a box border doubles the edge.
- Don't promote Ember Signal #f79942 to badges, links or a second CTA — orange is non-negotiable mockup-only decoration, and outside screenshots it splits the one-hue budget.
- Don't track mono labels wider than 0.33px at 11px — airy 0.1em label spacing turns build-log density into fashion-brand captioning.
- Don't replace the layered glass stacks with a single `0 4px 12px` drop shadow — the inset white highlights in `--shadow-lg` are what make pills read as lit acrylic, and you must never flatten them.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- feature surface: #0000000a (Mist Panel)
- hero ground: #05061b (Onyx Night)
- primary text: #141414 (Carbon Ink)
- secondary text: #656565 (Graphite Caption)
- hairline: #00000014 (Fog Hairline)

Place it beside a secondary pill with background #ffffff0a, text #ffffff, padding 7px 16px and the same 999px radius, with a 12px gap between them.

2. Build a hero section: a full-width band with a vertical gradient starting at #05061b and fading through electric blue into #ffffff over roughly 2,400px, with content centred in a 1128px container. Below, 40px down, add a 960px window mockup at 14px radius with a 28px translucent #ffffff14 title bar.

The top 240px holds an illustration or a nested white tile (#ffffff, radius 20px, padding 18px 20px, shadow `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04) 0px 12px 12px -3px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02) 0px 6px 6px -3px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02) 0px 3px 3px -1.5px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03) 0px 1px 1px -0.5px`) labelled in Geist Mono 11px weight 500 uppercase at #141414 and #999999. Arrange two panels per row with a 16px gap.

4. Build a navigation bar: height 96px, static, transparent over #05061b, inner container 1128px with space-between. On the left place a 32px app icon at 7.25px radius plus "for Electron" in Inter 16px weight 400 #ffffff with an 8px gap. In the centre place links Docs, Changelog and Blog in Inter 14px weight 400 at #ffffffb8, padding 8px 12px, radius 25px, with a #ffffff0a hover background. ## Components

### Pill Button — Signal Blue (Primary)

**Role:** The single conversion action per view

A lit cobalt capsule. Background #0036ff, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 999px, padding 7px 10px 7px 14px, height 36px, Inter at 16px weight 400 with 24px line height, a trailing 12px chevron, and shadow `--shadow-lg`, whose three inset white highlights give the fill a convex, backlit edge. The asymmetric padding makes room for the chevron, and the weight-400 label is deliberately quiet. The color does the shouting, so use exactly one per viewport.

### Pill Button — Smoked Glass (Secondary)

**Role:** Secondary paths like docs, login

A translucent glass capsule. Background #ffffff0a, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 999px, padding 7px 16px, height 36px, Inter at 16px weight 400, and shadow `--shadow-lg-2`, whose -4px inset glow from below reads as frosted acrylic over the night gradient. It shares the primary's exact geometry so the pair aligns as a set, and it differs only in fill. ## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline in Aeonik Pro weight 500 with -1.5% tracking (-1.11px at 74px, -0.72px at 48px) — weight 500 gives authority on the gradient without the heaviness of 700.
- Open each section with a Geist Mono 11px weight 500 uppercase eyebrow at 0.33px tracking inside a 999px pill — the mono label is the page's most frequent style and its developer signature.
- Descend from Onyx Night #05061b to Paper Canvas #ffffff exactly once per page — the single sunrise is the narrative, and repeating it flattens it.
- Reserve Signal Blue #0036ff for the primary pill, active toggles and the support launcher — one action color keeps the click path unambiguous.
- Separate surfaces by tone, using Mist Panel #0000000a under #ffffff tiles with `--shadow-sm` — tonal stacking replaces bordered boxes.
- Nest radii concentrically: a 24px panel, then a 20px tile, then 14px windows, then 10px images — the corners read as one machined object.
- Keep body copy at Inter 14px weight 400 with 22px leading in #656565 — explanation should stay quieter than the 48px headings above it.

### Don't

- Don't set Aeonik headlines at weight 700 — the 500 cut against -1.5% tracking is the signature, and bold turns the composed sunrise into a generic launch page.
- Don't keep the whole page dark — the thesis is a descent from night to white paper, and the conventional dev-tool all-dark scheme deletes the arrival at #ffffff.
- Don't use 8px rounded rectangles for buttons — every clickable shape is a 999px capsule, and a square corner reads as a foreign component.
- Don't add a 1px #00000014 border around Feature Panel Cards — the 4% #0000000a tint already separates them, and a box border doubles the edge.
- Don't promote Ember Signal #f79942 to badges, links or a second CTA — orange is non-negotiable mockup-only decoration, and outside screenshots it splits the one-hue budget.
- Don't track mono labels wider than 0.33px at 11px — airy 0.1em label spacing turns build-log density into fashion-brand captioning.
- Don't replace the layered glass stacks with a single `0 4px 12px` drop shadow — the inset white highlights in `--shadow-lg` are what make pills read as lit acrylic, and you must never flatten them.

## Night-to-Day Descent

The defining discipline is a single sunrise. The page starts on Onyx Night #05061b and, over the first three screens, brightens through electric blue into sky and then into Paper Canvas #ffffff, where all feature, pricing and footer content lives. Dark is a place you leave, not a theme you stay in. The arc breaks if you insert a second dark band below the fold, end the page on a dark footer, or start the hero on white, because each reverses the narrative from "your app arrives in daylight" to an ordinary alternating rhythm. To extend the system, put new marketing sections on #ffffff with #0000000a panels. Put any new dark content, such as terminal output or code, inside window mockups at 14px or 10px radius, so the night appears only as a screen within the day, never as a page surface.

## Mono Label Discipline

Geist Mono 500 at 11px uppercase appears on 256 elements, more than every Inter style combined at that tier. This is a page where labels outnumber sentences. The discipline is that anything categorical uses this register: eyebrows, platform names, build status and timestamps. Anything explanatory uses Inter 14px at #656565, and nothing in between mixes them. The rule breaks if a mono label grows past 12px, takes tracking wider than 0.33px, or switches to sentence case, because each drifts from build log toward a decorative caption. It also breaks if Inter capitals start doing eyebrow work. To extend it, put new metadata in mono at #999999 on paper or #ffffff on glass, and put numbers that users compare, such as prices, in Aeonik rather than mono.

## Glass Pill Grammar

Every clickable thing is a 999px capsule wearing a multi-layer shadow with white inset highlights. The primary pill uses nine layers and the secondary uses eight, compared with the single soft drop shadow most component kits ship. This grammar makes controls read as lit acrylic objects resting on the gradient. It breaks if buttons drop to 6px or 8px radii, lose the inset highlights, or take a flat 1px border instead of the `rgba(5, 6, 27, 0.74)` ring. Any of those turns the glass into a plain web form. To extend it, give new interactive controls the same 36px height, the same 7px vertical padding, the same 999px radius and one of the four glass shadow stacks. Panels and windows keep their 24px, 20px and 14px radii, because the pill shape signals "clickable" and must stay exclusive to clickable things.
